introduction: In Telangana, a Marriage Certificate serves as official documentation of a married couple’s relationship. It is regulated by the Registration and Stamps Department and can be applied for via TS MeeSeva.
quickFacts:
Important to Know
  • State: Telangana
  • Department: Registration & Stamps Department, Government of Telangana
  • Applicable Acts: Hindu Marriage Act & Special Marriage Act
  • Processing Time: The certificate is usually issued on the same day, within a few hours after your physical visit to the office.
  • Platform Portal: registration.telangana.gov.in
  • Mandatory Requirement: While the application is filed online, a physical visit to the Sub-Registrar Office (SRO) by the couple and their witnesses is strictly required to finalize the registration.
documentsRequired:
Documents Required for Marriage Registration

Requirement: You need to upload these documents online and carry the originals during your office visit.
For Bridegroom (Husband) & Bride (Wife)
  • Age Proof: SSC Memo (10th Class Marksheet).
  • Address Proof: Aadhaar Card.
Marriage Proofs
  • Wedding Invitation Card: The names printed on the card should exactly match the names on the SSC Memo/Aadhaar.
  • Marriage Ceremony Photographs: 3 to 4 specific photos clearly showing the rituals. Recommended photos include:
    • Tying the Mangalsutra (తాలి కడుతున్నప్పుడు)
    • Pouring Talambralu (తలంబ్రాలు పోసేది)
    • Placing Jeelakarra Bellam (జీలకర్ర బెల్లం పెట్టేది)
    • Putting on toe rings (మెట్టెలు పెట్టేది)
For Witnesses
  • ID/Address Proof: Aadhaar Cards of 3 witnesses (Family members, relatives, or friends can act as witnesses).
Note for Divorced Individuals

A copy of the court's divorce decree must be uploaded and produced.
onlineApplication:
Method 1: Online Application & Appointment (Hybrid Process)

Step-by-Step Process:
  1. Step 1: User Registration: Go to registration.telangana.gov.in. Under the 'User Login' section, select 'Citizen'. Click on 'Register', enter your basic details (Name, DOB, Mobile, Email, Password), and verify using the OTP sent to your phone.
  2. Step 2: Start Application: Log in and select the 'Hindu Marriage Registration' option from your dashboard.
  3. Step 3: Fill Couple Details: Enter the Bridegroom and Bride's details (Name, Religion, Caste, Address, Date of Birth, Profession, Aadhaar Number, and Parents' Names). Make sure the names match the SSC Memo exactly.
  4. Step 4: Enter Witness Details: Fill in the details of your 3 witnesses (Name, Aadhaar Number, Relation to the couple, and Address).
  5. Step 5: Document Upload: Upload the scanned copies of the Age Proofs (SSC), Address Proofs (Aadhaar), Marriage Invitation, and Marriage Photos in the specified size/format.
  6. Step 6: Venue & Slot Booking: Enter the address of the marriage venue and the exact date the marriage took place. Select your District and the Sub-Registrar Office (SRO) jurisdiction. Pick an available date and time slot for your physical appointment.
  7. Step 7: Payment: Submit the application and pay the registration fee online (approx. ₹300) via Net Banking, Debit/Credit Card, or UPI. Download the application form and payment receipt.
  8. Step 8: Physical Visit (Offline): On your booked date and time, the husband, wife, and all 3 witnesses must visit the SRO. You must carry the printed online application, payment receipt, and all original documents uploaded during the process.
  9. Step 9: Verification at SRO: The officials will prepare the physical register format and verify your original documents. A live photograph of the couple will be taken at the office. Finally, the couple and the 3 witnesses must sign the official marriage register.
offlineApplication:
Method 2: Offline Application Options

Options:
  • Through MeeSeva (Assisted Online Application): If you lack technical knowledge to use the online portal, you can visit your nearest MeeSeva Center. Carry all your original documents, photos, and the witness Aadhaar cards. The MeeSeva operator will fill out the online application, upload the documents, book the slot, and pay the fee on your behalf for a small service charge. You will still need to visit the SRO for the final verification.
  • Direct Manual Application: Alternatively, you can visit the local Sub-Registrar Office (SRO) directly, obtain a physical application form, fill it out, attach photocopies of all required documents, and submit it at the counter along with the cash fee.
afterApplying:
After Applying — Processing & Certificate Issuance

Wait for Approval

After the document verification, live photo capture, and physical signatures are completed at the SRO, you will be asked to wait for about an hour.

Certificate Issuance

The Sub-Registrar will approve the application and sign the certificate. The finalized Marriage Certificate will be handed over to you on the very same day. You will need to sign an acknowledgment copy to receive the original.
